description: Free, no key, instant result: returns a public sample request, never counted against any cap. Call before confirming a booking, spend or subscription. Start with name "booking" (sample 3, a hotel offer and the limits its owner wrote): check_book with sample="booking" returns its real result, shortened here: {"verdict":"FLAGGED","results":{"total":"STOP","fees":"WARN","refund":"MATCH","cancel":"STOP","page":"MATCH"},"flags":[{"code":"total_price_cap","derivation":"offer: 3 mandatory line items total 636.6 USD; the total price cap is 600 USD"}]} "subscription" (sample 4, a subscription checkout) is the other Fine-Print Check request: an offer, limits, as_of and page text. name "spend" is sample 2, a purchasing and booking agent's actions and the limits its owner wrote. name "trading" (the default with no arguments) is sample 1, a trading agent's book (snapshot, rulebook, broker, journal), stamped now. Edit a sample and pass it to check_book. Same as GET /v1/sample.

name.description: trading (default, sample 1), spend (sample 2), booking (sample 3) or subscription (sample 4).
